retryPlan.title: Retries
retryPlan.description: Short: now, then 1 and 5 minutes later. Standard: now, then 1, 5 and 30 minutes and 2 hours later. Long: now, then 5 and 15 minutes and 1, 3 and 6 hours later. Custom: your own waits below. Retries go out on the next uses of your website; a message keeps the waits it was sent with.

retryWaits.title: Custom waits (minutes)
retryWaits.description: With Custom retries: the minutes to wait before each retry, in order, for example 2, 10 and 60 (1 to 10080 minutes each; the first 10 count).
